newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Nov silver imports rise 35.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Nov silver imports rise 35.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's silver imports in November rose 35.6 percent from a year earlier to 91.09 tonnes, Finance Ministry data released on Thursday showed.

A Japanese bullion house official attributed the rise in part to the Japanese government's plan to conduct a tender in January next year for silver coins to be issued for the Nagano Winter Olympic Games in 1998.
"The government needs about 70 tonnes of silver for the tender," he said.
The figures released by MOF were as follows (in tonnes):
Cumulative imports in the first 11 months of 1996 were 1,192.15 tonnes against 1,144.94 in the year-ago period.
The ministry on Thursday morning released data showing an unprecedented surge in November silver imports to more than 8,000 tonnes, but issued a correction later in the day.
